interactions.effect_en: Raises INR (warfarin works more strongly), with a risk of bleeding.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令INR（凝血指數）升高，即係華法林藥力變強，有出血風險。
interactions.why_en: Danshen can thin the blood a little on its own. Studies also suggest it may slow down how fast your body clears warfarin, and free up more active warfarin in your blood. Together, these can make warfarin work more strongly.
interactions.why_zh: 丹參本身有輕微「薄血」作用。研究亦提示，佢可能減慢身體清除華法林嘅速度，同埋令血液入面有效嘅華法林增加。以上幾樣加埋，可以令華法林藥力變強。
interactions.why_pro_en: (1) Danshen inhibits platelet aggregation and affects other parts of coagulation (Chan 2001). (2) In rats, danshen reduced warfarin clearance and raised warfarin levels (Chan 2001); tanshinones may inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP1A2, which metabolise warfarin, based mainly on rat data (Zhuang 2021). (3) In laboratory studies, tanshinone IIA (as sodium tanshinone IIA sulfonate) and Salvia extracts may displace warfarin from albumin, raising free warfarin (Zhuang 2021).
interactions.action_en: Talk to your doctor before taking these together. If you do take both, clotting (INR) tests 2–3 times a week are advised. Tell your doctor that you take danshen.
interactions.action_zh: 兩樣一齊食之前，請先同醫生傾。如果兩樣都要食，建議每星期驗2至3次凝血指數（INR）。請話俾醫生知你有食丹參。

sources.label: Yu, Chan & Sanderson. J Intern Med 1997
Izzat et al. Ann Thorac Surg 1998
South China Morning Post, 27 Sep 2026 (Hospital Authority rating)

interactions.effect_en: INR more than doubled in a case report.
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告指，INR（凝血指數）升高超過一倍。
interactions.why_en: Dong quai contains coumarin-like compounds, which may reduce blood clotting. The exact mechanism of this interaction is not known.
interactions.why_zh: 當歸含有香豆素類物質，可能有「薄血」作用。呢個相互作用嘅確實原理仲未清楚。
interactions.why_pro_en: Contains coumarin-like constituents that may inhibit platelet aggregation; a single-dose animal study found no change in PT or warfarin pharmacokinetics (Zhuang 2021). The case report authors state that the mechanism is unknown (Page & Lawrence 1999).
interactions.action_en: Talk to your doctor before taking these together. Ask your doctor about an INR (clotting) test.
interactions.action_zh: 兩樣一齊食之前，請先同醫生傾。問醫生需唔需要驗INR（凝血指數）。

interactions.effect_en: Lowers warfarin's effect (INR goes down), so warfarin may protect you less well against blood clots.
interactions.effect_zh: 會減弱華法林藥力（INR下降），即係華法林預防血栓（血塊）嘅效果可能變差。
interactions.why_en: In a trial, people taking American ginseng had less warfarin in their blood, so warfarin worked less well.
interactions.why_zh: 有一項臨床試驗發現，食花旗參嘅人血液入面嘅華法林減少咗，所以華法林效果變差。
interactions.why_pro_en: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 20 healthy volunteers: after 2 weeks of American ginseng, peak INR, INR AUC, peak plasma warfarin and warfarin AUC were all significantly lower than with placebo (Yuan 2004). The mechanism is not established in our sources.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor that you take American ginseng. An INR (clotting) check may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知你有食花旗參。可能需要驗INR（凝血指數）。

sources.label: Yuan et al. Ann Intern Med 2004

interactions.effect_en: Trials found no effect on INR, but one case report found a drop in INR.
interactions.effect_zh: 臨床試驗發現對INR（凝血指數）冇影響，但有一個病例報告發現INR下降。
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor that you take Asian ginseng.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知你有食人參。

sources.label: Lim et al. Singapore Med J 2018

interactions.effect_en: Bleeding has been seen in case reports, but controlled trials found no significant effect.
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告出現出血，但有對照嘅臨床試驗未有發現明顯影響。
interactions.action_en: Mention it to your doctor. Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。留意有冇唔尋常嘅瘀傷或者出血。

sources.label: Lim et al. Singapore Med J 2018

interactions.effect_en: Bleeding has been seen in case reports, but controlled trials found no significant effect, even with aspirin.
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告出現出血，但有對照嘅臨床試驗未有發現明顯影響，就算同阿士匹靈一齊食都係咁。
interactions.action_en: Mention it to your doctor. Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。留意有冇唔尋常嘅瘀傷或者出血。

sources.label: Lim et al. Singapore Med J 2018

interactions.effect_en: Lowers potassium, which can increase digoxin's effect.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令血鉀下降，可能增強地高辛嘅藥力。
interactions.why_en: Liquorice makes your kidneys lose potassium, in a similar way to the hormone aldosterone.
interactions.why_zh: 甘草會令腎臟流失鉀質，作用類似荷爾蒙「醛固酮」。
interactions.why_pro_en: Glycyrrhizin metabolites inhibit 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11β-HSD2) in the kidney, increasing mineralocorticoid receptor activity (pseudoaldosteronism) and causing potassium loss (Yoshino 2021). The Cleveland Clinic interaction table lists liquorice with digoxin as causing loss of serum potassium, and as potentiating cardiac glycosides.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor. A potassium blood test may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。可能需要驗血檢查鉀質水平。

interactions.effect_en: Lowers potassium. Potassium-losing diuretics such as furosemide also lower it, so the effects add up.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令血鉀下降。呋塞米呢類利尿藥本身都會令血鉀下降，兩樣加埋效果會疊加。
interactions.why_en: Liquorice makes your kidneys lose potassium, in a similar way to the hormone aldosterone.
interactions.why_zh: 甘草會令腎臟流失鉀質，作用類似荷爾蒙「醛固酮」。
interactions.why_pro_en: Glycyrrhizin metabolites inhibit 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11β-HSD2) in the kidney, increasing mineralocorticoid receptor activity (pseudoaldosteronism) and causing potassium loss; concurrent diuretic use is a listed risk factor (Yoshino 2021). The Cleveland Clinic interaction table lists additive effects with potassium-depleting diuretics.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor. A potassium blood test may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。可能需要驗血檢查鉀質水平。

interactions.effect_en: Can act as a hidden extra statin dose, raising the risk of statin side effects such as muscle and liver problems.
interactions.effect_zh: 可能令你喺唔知情之下額外食多一份他汀類藥物，增加肌肉同肝臟問題等副作用嘅風險。
interactions.why_en: Some red yeast rice products contain monacolin K, which is chemically the same as the statin medicine lovastatin.
interactions.why_zh: 部分紅麴產品含有莫納可林K（monacolin K），化學上同他汀類藥物「洛伐他汀」一樣。
interactions.why_pro_en: Monacolin K is chemically identical to lovastatin, so products containing substantial amounts can cause the same side effects and drug interactions as lovastatin. Separately, some products are contaminated with citrinin, which may cause kidney damage (NCCIH).
interactions.action_en: Do not combine without asking your doctor.
interactions.action_zh: 未問過醫生之前，唔好紅麴同他汀類藥物兩樣都食。

sources.label: US NIH National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH): Red yeast rice
